data.name: Pradyuman
data.long_meaning: Pradyuman is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pradat' which means 'gift'. The name Pradyuman signifies the gift of a child to the parents, symbolizing the joy and happiness that a child brings to a family. It also represents intelligence, courage, and the nurturing qualities of the parents.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pradyuman is a name that signifies the divine gift of life and the blessings of the gods. It is believed that a child named Pradyuman will be blessed with intelligence, courage, and the ability to nurture and care for others.
data.numerology_meaning: Pradyuman is a name that represents new beginnings, leadership, and the ability to overcome obstacles with courage and determination.

The naming ritual is an essential part of Indian culture, and the name Pradyuman signifies the arrival of a new life into the world, which is celebrated with great joy and enthusiasm.
